entities.name: Samut
entities.description: A fugitive dissenter and former initiate of the Tah crop who tries to keep her friend Djeru from dying in the final Trial.

entities.name: Djeru
entities.description: A devout initiate and Samut's oldest friend, who wishes to die a glorious death in the final Trial of Zeal.

entities.name: Hazoret
entities.description: The jackal-headed god of zeal who presides over the final Trial and seizes Samut as a dissenter.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker and member of the Gatewatch, who rescues Samut and shields Djeru from Hazoret's spear.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A red-haired fire planeswalker of the Gatewatch who is furious that Liliana hid her demon.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A telepathic planeswalker of the Gatewatch who tells Samut the God-Pharaoh is a dragon from another world.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker of the Gatewatch who tracked Samut and learns how to break the cartouches' control.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A necromancer planeswalker of the Gatewatch who reveals that her third demon is on Amonkhet.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: A dragon from another world who rules Amonkhet as the God-Pharaoh and has remade the gods.

entities.name: Nakht
entities.description: Samut and Djeru's childhood friend, an aven who died in the desert and now roams the sands as the risen dead.

entities.name: Temmet
entities.description: A vizier whom Djeru thought could attest for Samut.

entities.name: Tah crop
entities.description: Samut's crop of initiates, which she has abandoned.

entities.name: The Gatewatch
entities.description: The group of planeswalkers, here Gideon, Chandra, Jace, Nissa and Liliana, who have come to Amonkhet to confront Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: The Gods of Amonkhet
entities.description: The five surviving gods of Amonkhet, tampered with by Bolas, who attend Hazoret's final Trial.

entities.name: The Anointed
entities.description: Mummified dead servants who hunt Samut and obey the gods.

entities.name: Trial of Zeal
entities.description: Hazoret's final Trial in which initiates must kill the dissenters, after which the Hours begin.

entities.name: The Hours
entities.description: The prophesied event that begins when the second sun passes through the horns, ushering in the God-Pharaoh's return.

entities.name: Hazoret's Monument
entities.description: A monument shaped like a god's head, whose innermost hearth-like temple Samut enters.

entities.name: Naktamun
entities.description: The city of Amonkhet where Samut hides.

entities.name: The Arena
entities.description: The great arena where the final Trial is held.

entities.name: The Luxa
entities.description: The river where the crowds rush as the Hours begin and the Gate to the Afterlife lies.

entities.name: Gate to the Afterlife
entities.description: The gate promised to open when the second sun sits between the horns.

entities.name: Ammits
entities.description: Demons that devour hearts, invoked by Hazoret as a curse.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: The desert plane ruled by the God-Pharaoh.

events.summary: Samut hides in an old embalming chamber after fleeing viziers and the anointed, and meets Djeru, who came disguised as a mummy.
events.quote: The wholesome face of her friend Djeru emerged

events.summary: Samut begs Djeru not to enter the final Trial, claiming the God-Pharaoh is a lie, but he refuses and walks out.
events.quote: Don't go to the final Trial.

events.summary: Samut mentions Nakht, and Djeru angrily says Nakht died unworthy because of their foolish trespass.
events.quote: Nakht died unworthy , out there in the dunes, because of our stupidity.

events.summary: Djeru leaves, saying he will plead to Hazoret for her, which gives Samut an idea.
events.quote: I'll plead to Hazoret for you.

events.summary: Samut enters Hazoret's monument and requests an audience with the god.
events.quote: I request an audience, mighty Hazoret.

events.summary: Samut asks Hazoret not to take Djeru's life, and Hazoret questions her right to cage his heart.
events.quote: I have come to plead for Djeru's survival.

events.summary: Samut dares to ask whether Hazoret herself is mistaken and appeals to the god of compassion she once was before the God-Pharaoh.
events.quote: Any tiny sliver of a memory of that time before the God-Pharaoh?

events.summary: Hazoret curses Samut and orders the anointed to seize the dissenter.
events.quote: Seize the dissenter.

events.summary: Samut is imprisoned in a sarcophagus among other dissenters, who tell her dissenters are the monsters of the Trial of Zeal.
events.quote: The monsters initiates face in the final Trial are the dissenters themselves.

events.summary: Samut explains that she needs to save Djeru, believing he could convince a god they were lied to.
events.quote: If anyone could convince a god they'd been lied to, it's him.

events.summary: Gideon and Chandra free Samut from the sarcophagus, telling her they came to rescue her.
events.quote: He explained that they saw her days ago evading capture and came to rescue her.

events.summary: The Gatewatch share information with Samut, learning that Bolas is a dragon from another world and has tampered with the gods.
events.quote: The God-Pharaoh is a dragon from another world, Samut.

events.summary: Liliana reveals her third demon is on Amonkhet, and the Gatewatch quarrel angrily.
events.quote: My third demon is here.

events.summary: Samut forces the group to focus on rescuing Djeru, and Gideon swears to help.
events.quote: I swear to help you save the life of your friend.

events.summary: All the gods approach and Hazoret takes Samut and the Gatewatch to face the last initiates, knocking them out.
events.quote: Your time has come

events.summary: The dissidents awake in the arena with cartouches of control, and Nissa learns to move against the cartouche by treating it like a leyline.
events.quote: They work like leylines

events.summary: Hazoret orders the initiates to kill the heretics and starts the final Trial, casting her mark of battle rage over everyone.
events.quote: Hazoret's mark of battle rage appeared over their heads.

events.summary: The Gatewatch fight without magic, and Samut reaches Djeru and fights alongside him.
events.quote: She would protect him. They would fight together.

events.summary: Djeru prays for Samut's forgiveness while he and Samut fight, and he slices Gideon's arm.
events.quote: cutting a sleek, shallow slice cut through Gideon's forearm

events.summary: The battle magic fades, and Djeru surrenders his khopesh and prays for Samut's glorified death.
events.quote: Djeru concluded with his khopesh on the ground, a formal surrender.

events.summary: Hazoret asks Djeru to claim his place, and he accepts, but Samut declines Hazoret's gift.
events.quote: Without hesitation, she shook her head.

events.summary: As Hazoret strikes, Samut tackles Djeru out of the way and Gideon blocks the spear with his golden barrier.
events.quote: He stood between them and Hazoret's spear

events.summary: Djeru, enraged that his chance at a glorious death is gone, beats on Gideon and weeps that he wants to exist.
events.quote: Because I want to exist!

events.summary: The second sun passes through the horns, a shadow crosses the arena, and the Hours begin.
events.quote: It has begun. The Hours have begun!

events.summary: Gideon, left behind, recalls Hazoret whispering to him that she sees his death and that he is no god.
events.quote: for I see your death, Kytheon Iora.
